events.subtitle: East African jazz piano trio
events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore presents the Aaron Rimbui Trio on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 7:00 PM. InstantSeats lists Aaron Rimbui on piano, Timothy Norton on bass and Temitope Idowu on drums. The venue describes Rimbui's music as a fusion of jazz piano and East African rhythm; Jazz Congress identifies the Kenyan-born pianist and composer as a major figure in East African jazz whose work has focused on bringing African jazz traditions into international jazz settings.

en.why_it_matters: Rimbui earns a RADAR slot because the piano language itself is the reason to listen: modern jazz harmony and trio interplay are pulled toward East African rhythmic ideas rather than treated as a generic world-music overlay. In a small room, with only bass and drums around him, that relationship between pulse, touch and phrasing should stay exposed.
en.trip_verdict: Worth knowing about and catching if the Baltimore date fits cleanly into the calendar, especially if the East African jazz thread or contemporary piano language is interesting. I would not displace a rarer master, premiere or one-off for this set.

es.why_it_matters: Rimbui entra al RADAR porque aquí el lenguaje del piano es la razón para escuchar: armonía de jazz moderno e interacción de trío jaladas hacia ideas rítmicas de África oriental, no una capa genérica de world music puesta encima. En una sala pequeña, con sólo bajo y batería alrededor, esa relación entre pulso, toque y fraseo debería quedar muy expuesta.
es.trip_verdict: Vale tenerlo presente y entrarle si la fecha de Baltimore cae limpia en el calendario, sobre todo si interesa el hilo de jazz de África oriental o el lenguaje contemporáneo del piano. No desplazaría por este set a un maestro más raro, un estreno o un one-off.
